schemaVersion: fsq.ai-test/v1
name: fsq-evidence-demo
description: Open http://127.0.0.1:8848/ in the browser, click Add to cart for the
  Field notebook, use a deterministic visible-text assertion to verify Added to cart,
  then close the browser. Keep this public demo to those actions.
platform: web
tags:
- recorded
- dynamic-llm
env: '[REDACTED]'
properties: {}
onCaseStart: []
onCaseComplete: []
---
- startBrowser: {}
- navigateTo:
    url: http://127.0.0.1:8848/
    waitUntil: domcontentloaded
- clickOn:
    target: button "Add to cart" [ref=e8]
    button: left
    double: false
- assertText:
    locator:
      text: Added to cart
    text:
      equals: Added to cart
    optional: false
- closeBrowser: {}
